title: Dex Nikana
extract:
The Dex Nikana is a Dex unique nikana released in celebration of WARFRAME's 11th Anniversary. Gains Melee Combo every 11 hits, but max multiplier is reduced to 11x.

Gains 1x Melee Combo every 11 hits (down from 20), but max multiplier is reduced to 11x (down from 12x).

Acquisition
The Dex Nikana was released in commemoration of WARFRAME's 11th Year Anniversary. It is obtainable through yearly anniversaries in March via Alerts, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

History
On its release, Dex Nikana was obtainable by logging in between March 27 to December 31, 2024.
